caseName: Perk v. Ohio ex rel. Corrigan
caseNameFull: PERK, AUDITOR OF CUYAHOGA COUNTY v. OHIO ex rel. CORRIGAN, PROSECUTING ATTORNEY OF CUYAHOGA COUNTY
attorneys: Gerald A. Donahue and Donald M. Robiner for appellant., John T. Corrigan, pro se, and John L. Dowling for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
